2 S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR, J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:8926-DB  MFA No. 104458 of 2022  JUDGMENT

This appeal by the claimant in MVC No.863/2019 on the file of Senior Civil Judge and Member,
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-VI, Kudligi, sitting at Sandur, is directed against the judgment and award dated 08.04.2022 whereby the claim petition filed by the appellant/claimant seeking compensation for the injuries sustained in a road traffic accident that occurred on 17.05.2019 was partly allowed by the Tribunal, awarding compensation of Rs.18,60,800/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till date of realization in favour of the appellant/claimant.
2. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that the Tribunal has come to the conclusion that the appellant/claimant was entitled to a sum of Rs.18,60,800/- by way of compensation.

However,
since the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal under various heads is inadequate and on the lower side, we deem it just and appropriate to direct payment of Rs.50,000/- in NC:
2023:KHC-D:8926-DB addition to compensation already awarded by the Tribunal, without interest,
by way of global compensation payable by the 3rd respondent/Insurance Company within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
3. In the result, the appeal is hereby partly allowed.

The impugned judgment and award, dated 08.04.2022, passed in M.V.C. No.863/2019 by the Tribunal is hereby modified directing the 3rd respondent/Insurance Company to pay a sum of Rs.50,000/- by way of global compensation,
without interest, to the appellant/claimant in addition to the compensation awarded by the Tribunal within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
